newsitem.title: USA: Foreigners hold $1 trillion in U.S. Treasuries-SIA.
newsitem.headline: Foreigners hold $1 trillion in U.S. Treasuries-SIA.

text.p: Foreign investors now hold more than $1.0 trillion of U.S. Treasuries, more than 30 percent of the amount privately held, according to a report by the Securities Industry Association.
Foreigners bought $73.5 billion of Treasuries in the third quarter of 1996, compared with $46.9 billion during the same period of 1995, the report said.
Total foreign investor purchases of U.S. Treasuries in 1996 should exceed $216 billion, up from $168.2 billion in 1995, it said.

"These inflows have a dual effect of ... holding down U.S. interest rates and freeing up capital for U.S. and foreign equity markets," David Strongin, SIA's director of international finance, said in a statement.
